name: stable nuclear fusion

VINIT.justification: uninitialized hydrogen isotopes before any reaction or containment

TANCH.justification: closed physical boundary containing the entire fusion system

AFWD.justification: directed energy input driving plasma toward ignition temperature

AREV.justification: removal of fusion products allowing descent back to steady state

CLINK.justification: sequential linking of toroidal and poloidal coils

IMSCRIB.justification: plasma state that recognizes and maintains its own ignition condition

FSPLIT.justification: closed magnetic surface splits into toroidal and poloidal flux components

FFUSE.justification: reconstitution of the original closed magnetic surface from the two flux branches

EVALT.justification: affirmative branch confirming Lawson criterion is met

EVALF.justification: negative branch indicating loss of confinement or temperature

ENGAGR.justification: paradice state where plasma is simultaneously confined and on the verge of disruption

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only record of neutron yield and wall damage

phase_3.void_description: unassembled fuel gas and inactive coils before any magnetic field or plasma exists
phase_3.true_description: stable ignited plasma satisfying Lawson criterion with net energy gain
phase_3.false_description: quenched or disrupted plasma with loss of confinement
phase_3.both_description: marginally stable plasma simultaneously confined and near disruption threshold

steps.domain_action: divide closed magnetic surface into toroidal and poloidal flux
apply toroidal-field ramp to toroidal branch
apply poloidal-field ramp to poloidal branch
confirm toroidal-poloidal balance reaches ignition threshold
detect imbalance leading to quench path
hold marginal stability state without resolution
chain successive field-line segments into continuous surface
plasma self-recognizes ignition and sustains burn
exhaust helium ash along reverse gradient
permanently record neutron fluence and wall exposure
recombine toroidal and poloidal fluxes into original closed surface

phase_5.compiler_frontend: magnetic-field coil drivers translating target q-profile into currents
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: electromagnetic wave coupling between plasma regions and external coils
phase_5.memory_mechanism: flux-surface integrals stored in real-time equilibrium reconstruction
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: real-time MHD stability controller ordering heating and fueling pulses
phase_5.alfs_store: reference Grad-Shafranov equilibrium database for bootstrap initialization

phase_6.cycle_cost: auxiliary heating power and fuel injection
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: sub-ignited plasma with external energy input
phase_6.post_cycle_state: self-sustaining ignited plasma with reduced external power
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — fusion energy release offsets auxiliary power once Lawson criterion is reached
